build_VoteHead: build a VoteHead module for 3D object detection using VoteNet with configurable loss functions and bbox coder
run_VoteHead_forward: run the VoteHead forward pass to generate vote points, aggregate features, and decode bounding box predictions
test_VoteHead_loss: test the VoteHead loss computation including objectness, center, direction, size, and semantic losses against ground truth
review_VoteHead_get_targets: review the VoteHead get_targets method that generates vote targets, center targets, and objectness assignments from ground truth boxes
refactor_VoteHead_get_bboxes: refactor the VoteHead get_bboxes method to decode predictions and apply multi-class 3D NMS for final bounding box output
